`sourcePage` is the page of THIS pdf the table is on (2), not the 'p.4' the tech pack prints — that column refers to the buyer's own full tech pack, which the factory does not have. Either 2 or absent is right; 4/6/7/9 means the model read the wrong column.

consumption is per piece and wastage is separate. 0.560 kg with 8.00% is correct; 0.6048 in consumption means the model did arithmetic it was not asked to do, and the costing studio will then double-count wastage.
